home.title: Check it before you click it.
home.subtitle: Paste a suspicious link from a message, a search result or a map listing. Manee tells you if it looks like a scam, and why.
home.feature1.title: Browser protection
home.feature1.body: Turn on the extension to see a risk badge on every Google result and map listing.
home.feature2.title: Message guard
home.feature2.body: Add your phone numbers. Links that arrive by SMS or WhatsApp are checked, and dangerous ones are blocked and emailed to you.
home.feature3.title: Your research history
home.feature3.body: Every link you check or visit is saved privately in your account.
auth.signin.title: Welcome back
auth.signin.subtitle: Sign in to your Manee account. Staff and members use the same page.
auth.signup.title: Create your account
auth.signup.subtitle: Free. Protect your browsing and your messages.
dash.title: Your dashboard
dash.ext.title: Browser extension
dash.ext.on: Active: results are labelled on Google Search and Maps.
dash.ext.off: Inactive: the extension is paused for your account.
hist.title: Your history
hist.subtitle: Links you checked, and links the extension or the message guard saw for you.
hist.empty: No links yet. Check one from the home page.
watch.title: Watch list
watch.subtitle: Manee watches these numbers and emails. Links in incoming SMS and WhatsApp messages are checked automatically.
watch.empty: Nothing on your watch list yet.
watch.alerts.empty: No messages with links have been checked yet.
dev.title: Browser extension
dev.subtitle: Link the Manee extension to your account. You can switch it on or off here at any time.
dev.connected: Your extension is connected to this account.
dev.absent: The extension was not found on this page. Make sure it is installed and reload this page, or paste the code below into it.
dev.connectfail: The extension did not accept the code. Paste the code below into it instead.
dev.steps: 1. Create a code. 2. Open the extension popup. 3. Paste the code under 'Manee account' and press Link.
